canonical.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
canonical.sourceFilePath: 09. Heaps/3. Hard Problems/03. Kth largest element in stream.cpp

narrative.title: The Trading Day Leaderboard Feed
narrative.scenario: A trading floor's ticker appends new prices continuously, and the desk's display must show the kth-highest price after every append — it cannot re-sort a growing history on each tick. The display keeps a small pen holding only the k highest prices seen so far; each append either joins the pen or is discarded, and the pen's weakest resident is always the current kth-highest.
narrative.inputFormat: An integer k, the initial array nums, and a list of appended values.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the list of kth-largest values after each append, in order.

testCases.explanation: Each append reshuffles the pen of the three highest prices; its weakest resident is reported.
With k=1 the display simply tracks the running maximum.

hintLevels: Level 1: The answer only depends on the k best values seen so far — everything else is forgettable.
Level 2: A min-heap of size k holds exactly those; the top is the kth largest.
Level 3: Overflow handling makes the constructor identical to add() — one push, maybe one pop.
